components.description: Paid leave at full salary and benefits for up to one academic semester for a bargaining-unit member upon the birth or adoption of a (pre-school age) child; runs concurrent with FMLA; at most two such paid leaves per member during employment.

notes: 2018_00_link.txt is an HR leave index page (Last Updated 2/28/18) that holds no policy text of its own beyond cross-references.

Governing document: the UT-AAUP collective bargaining agreement (tenured and tenure-track unit), Contract #2 in force July 1, 2017 - June 30, 2018, which covers the reference date 2018-02-26. The unit is all tenured and tenure-track full-time faculty except the College of Law and the College of Medicine and Life Sciences, so it holds main-campus arts-and-sciences and engineering faculty (V3).

Calendar: the CBA states a semester calendar ('For nine (9) month faculty the work year shall consist of two semesters') without a length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: Family Childcare Leave, paid at full salary, up to one semester (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c4) concurrent from its start. Separately, sick leave (c3, own balance) lies within the unpaid child-care leave for the remainder of the birth term (c2, FMLA concurrent); then, at the university's discretion, unpaid medical leave up to two years (c5) after sick leave is exhausted. c1 and c2 are not linked.

Non-birth parent chain: Family Childcare Leave up to one semester (c1) with FMLA concurrent (c4); separately, the unpaid child-care leave for the remainder of the birth term (c2) after any paid sick leave is exhausted; c1 and c2 are not linked.

c1 and c2: the CBA does not say whether a parent may take the unpaid child-care leave for the birth term (15.3.1.2) and then Family Childcare Leave in the following semester (15.1.3.2 lets 9-month faculty choose Fall or Spring). Left unlinked (not added); flagged on c2.

c3 sick leave: HR Policy 3364-25-125 (Main Campus) restates the accrual (15 workdays a year) and requires a pregnant employee to use accrued sick leave for maternity-related leaves of absence under FMLA; the CBA governs members. FMLA policy requires exhausting sick, vacation and other paid leave before unpaid FMLA leave.
c6 Sick Leave Bank: Appendix C excludes maternity leave and family care; recorded for completeness, own_balance (R1d).

Not components: sabbatical leave (15.1.6), Special Assignment Leave (15.2), jury duty (15.1.4), bereavement leave (15.5), holidays: none can be taken because of a birth or adoption. Art. 10.3.2.3 ('If unforeseen events should occur during the year, said member's Assignment may be modified') is a general workload clause with no parental relief; not coded. Art. 8.1.5 scholarly or professional leave counting toward probation is not parental.

Cross-references not saved: Policy 3364-25-26 Unpaid Leave for Personal Reasons (flagged on c12); Policy 3364-25-08 Jury or Trial Participation Leave (not parental); Policy 3364-25-123 HSC Leaves of Absence (saved as 2018_01 but not used: Health Science Campus); the University's Long Term Disability policy (flagged on c7); 29 C.F.R. 825 (flagged on c4); HR Policy 3364-25-125 'section on Leave of Absence' and 'section on Reporting of Absences' (flagged on c3); the Group Medical Plan document and UT health plan definitions (not leave).
